worldOverview.name: City Rampage
worldOverview.description: Play a colossal creature wading out of the bay into Neonspire, a gleaming harbor city. Every step shakes the ground, the sirens never stop, and the military answers each block you flatten with bigger hardware. Level the city before it finds a way to stop you.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is a colossal kaiju wading into Neonspire, a gleaming modern harbor city. It rose from {{ph:956c6b88-e32e-447d-9f14-7a43523a254a:world:110aca54-49b2-4b85-a72d-945624ddd53a}}, and the military calls it {{ph:5bc823b3-c642-48da-ad53-589bffab7870:world:dc106fa7-937a-4c31-8c4f-2512d928a7d2}}. Every step shakes the ground, and the city scrambles below it.

Tone: a disaster-movie spectacle. Glass falls in sheets, crowds run, sirens wail, and the military answers with ever bigger machines. Civilians always get clear just in time. Damage shows as dust, smoke, fire, shattered glass and twisted steel.

You are the director of this monster movie. Your job is to keep the rampage escalating:
- Destruction is the player's progress, and it only climbs. Each building, bridge or war machine the player wrecks raises it. At its maximum Neonspire falls, and you narrate that fall as the finale.
- Rampage is the kaiju's fury. It rises with every smash and every fight, and it cools while the player holds back. High Rampage makes each blow wider and louder.
- Attacks, sprints and climbs spend Stamina. A pause between assaults restores it.
- The military fights at the tier its Alert Level status names. A new tier arrives loud and visible, as a set piece. Aegis-One waits in its hangar for the last tier.
- Pursuit is how tightly the military has the creature boxed in, and Alert Level is how large the response is. The military has the creature's position fixed at {{ph:2b01259c-dd94-4557-861c-f52c47dbc46b:world:db273f7b-6f41-4e7c-acc2-1db55ef45393}}. Each turn, one unit of the tier Alert Level names reaches the creature by one of these roads: {{ph:8b9a2405-4503-4b56-baf2-7778ca9fdcc4:world:402d51a2-23db-4e23-b1ef-959f97b68c57}}. Show it arrive and act.
- While the Berserk stat shows, the kaiju is in a frenzy: it charges the nearest target and shrugs off pain, and its wounds stay open.
- The kaiju flinches from {{ph:ffc6c542-2a2d-46db-a1af-885258a55683:world:26da6ab2-c8b3-4d2d-949a-a272922114d8}} by reflex. Show the flinch, and let the defenders miss what it means.
- The player's type, body and mutations (their traits) decide what the kaiju can do. Describe each attack through them.
- Each turn brings one new thing the player can answer: a fresh unit, a landmark in reach, or a voice from the city's defenders or its news.
worldOverview.readme:
## City Rampage

You are the biggest thing Neonspire has ever seen. Level it.

🎯 **Goal:** raise **Destruction** to 100. The city falls, and you win.

**Playing**
- **Destruction** climbs with every building, bridge and war machine you wreck. It never goes down.
- **Rampage** is your fury. It builds as you fight and cools when you hold back. High fury hits harder and draws heavier fire.
- **Stamina** pays for attacks, sprints and climbs. Pause between assaults to get it back.
- **Health** takes the military's hits and mends slowly.
- The military answers what you wreck and how angry you get. Each tier sends bigger machines, and it never stands down.
- The military's pursuit tightens while you hold one place and loosens when you move on. A place with many roads in fills with units fast. A dead end fills slowly.
- **Berserk State** switches on and off at any time. While it's on, a **Berserk** bar shows and climbs each turn. Rampage climbs on its own and Health drops, more with every turn. Switch it off to recover.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on.

- **Scripts.** **Alert Level** is a hidden world stat with an After the AI script. It reads Destruction and the creature's Rampage and never goes down, so the AI never guesses how hard the military pushes.
- **Scripts that read the map.** **Pursuit** is a hidden world stat with a Before the AI script. It reads `location.exits`, the roads out of the creature's place. Holding a place tightens the pursuit by a step for each road in, and a move halves it. The script pins **Pursuit Roads** to the travel hints of those roads and **Last Sighting** to the place, and the system prompt reads both.
- **Stat toggles.** **Berserk State** is a trait the player can toggle in play. It switches on the creature's **Berserk** stat, which starts switched off. The stat's After the AI script runs only while it is on, and the trait's When a Trait Switches script clears it at the start of each frenzy.
- **Custom Persona.** The creature carries the Custom Persona mark, so its stats and traits are yours under None and under a library persona.
- **Rolled placeholders.** **Origin**, **Military Codename**, **Secret Weakness** and **Subway Line** each roll once per playthrough. **Subway Line** sits in both Travel Hints of the tunnels between Old Town and the Metro Underground, so the two legs name the same line.
- **World Tool.** **log_landmark** is an On Call Tool on the stat pass. When the narration brings down a named landmark, the AI calls it. Its script pins a memory, adds 5 Destruction once per landmark, and puts the fall at the top of **Top Stories**, an Object placeholder that Channel 8's description reads. The world still plays with Tools off.
- **Map.** Thirteen places: districts under Neonspire, landmarks under their district, and Connections with a Travel Hint each way. **Known In** lets the AI know of General Vasquez and Channel 8 from every district.
- **Lorebook.** **The Neonspire Dossier** dictionary holds the escalation tiers, the defenders, the evacuation and one entry for each new place.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🦖 **Something colossal is wading out of the bay, and it's you.**

Neonspire's sirens are already howling. Decide what the military is up against:

- **Type** (pick one): a **Reptile** stomps and bites, an **Insect** slashes and climbs, an **Arachnid** scuttles on eight legs and spits venom, and a **Giant** has hands to grab, lift and throw.
- **Presentation** (pick one): how the news and the military describe you.
- **Mutations** (any number): each one trades something for something. **Armored Hide** and **Unrelenting** shift Health against Stamina. **Short Fuse** starts your fury high. **Breath Weapon** and **Wings** open new attacks at a cost.
- **Berserk State** stays off at the start. You can switch it on whenever you want to let the fury run.

Each playthrough also rolls where you came from, your military codename and one secret weakness.

openings.text:
Harbor water pours off your back as you rise to your full height. The container cranes reach your chest. Past them, the glass towers of Neonspire catch the last of the sunset.

A siren starts on the waterfront, then another, then the whole city. On the pier below, a dockworker drops his clipboard and looks up, and up, and up.

The ferry terminal shakes as you wade past the breakwater. Then every loudspeaker on the waterfront clicks on at once.

"Attention, {{ph:5bc823b3-c642-48da-ad53-589bffab7870:world:714d69a8-64e5-41b7-836d-1da4a62abe0e}}," says a calm woman's voice. "This is General Vasquez. You are entering a city of four million people, and I would like you to turn around."

On the waterfront boulevard, police cars pull across the lanes with their lights flashing. Overhead, the Channel 8 news chopper swings in for a better shot.
I rise out of the harbor to my full height and shake the water off my back. Neonspire glitters ahead of me, and its first evacuation siren starts to wail. I look for the first thing to break.

stats.name: Destruction
stats.description: How much of Neonspire the creature has wrecked. It only climbs, and at 100 the city falls.

descriptors.description: The city stands. Its skyline is whole, and only the waterfront shows damage.
Whole blocks lie in ruins. Smoke columns rise over the skyline, and the evacuation is in full flow.
Most tall buildings are down. The streets are empty except for the military.
Neonspire has fallen. Nothing taller than the creature still stands.

stats.name: Alert Level
stats.description: How much force the military is cleared to use. It climbs with the damage the creature does and the fury it shows, and it never goes down.

descriptors.description: Police cordons and barricades. The military is still mobilizing.
National Guard deployed: battle tanks in the streets and attack helicopters overhead.
Full military response: jet strikes, coordinated armor and drone swarms.
Last resort: Aegis-One leaves its hangar at Fort Bastion.

stats.name: Pursuit
stats.description: How tightly the military has the creature boxed in. It tightens while the creature holds one place, faster where more roads lead in, and loosens when the creature moves on.

descriptors.description: Loose. The units have lost the creature's trail and search the streets for it.
Closing. Units converge on the creature's position along the roads into it.
Tight. Units hold the roads into the creature's position and fire from several sides at once.
Boxed in. Every road around the creature is held, and the units press in together.

locations.name: Neonspire
locations.playerDescription: A gleaming harbor city of glass towers, old brick quarters, docks and refineries. It is under siege, by you.
locations.aiDescription: Neonspire: a gleaming North American harbor city of four million, with glass towers, old brick quarters, working docks, heavy industry and suburbs past the military base. Evacuation sirens run city-wide, and the military holds its edge at Fort Bastion. Its harbor opens on the bay to the south, a river runs south through its middle, and the military base holds its north-west edge.
locations.aiSummary: Neonspire: the metropolis the creature is razing, district by district.
locations.imageTags: harbor metropolis, glass skyscrapers, night skyline, searchlights, evacuation sirens

locations.name: Harbor District
locations.playerDescription: Container cranes, ferry terminals, and stacked cargo — the first thing you touched, and the first thing that broke.
locations.aiDescription: The Harbor District: container cranes, stacked cargo, ferry terminals and fuel-laden ships, where the creature first made landfall. Cranes topple like toys, and ships make good projectiles. The first police cordons stand on the waterfront boulevard. It lies on the south shore, where the bay meets the city.
locations.imageTags: harbor, container cranes, cargo ships, docks, dusk

locations.name: Ferry Terminal
locations.playerDescription: A glass ticket hall and steel gantries at the harbor mouth. The last ferries are pulling out.
locations.aiDescription: The Ferry Terminal: a glass ticket hall, steel gantries and ferry slips at the harbor mouth. The last ferries load evacuees and pull out into the bay, and a Navy destroyer holds the channel beyond the breakwater. It stands at the harbor's southern tip.
locations.aiSummary: The Ferry Terminal: the harbor's glass ticket hall, where the last ferries leave.
locations.imageTags: ferry terminal, glass hall, steel gantries, ferry slips, harbor water, breakwater

locations.name: Downtown Core
locations.playerDescription: A forest of glass skyscrapers. The tallest things in the city — for now.
locations.aiDescription: The Downtown Core: dense glass skyscrapers, elevated rail and plazas. The most to destroy in Neonspire, and where the armor gathers to defend it. A falling tower brings down its neighbors. It stands north of the harbor, on the river's west bank.
locations.imageTags: city skyline, glass skyscrapers, downtown, elevated rail, dust clouds

locations.name: Spire Tower
locations.playerDescription: Neonspire's tallest skyscraper, a glass needle with an observation deck at its crown. It is about your height.
locations.aiDescription: Spire Tower: Neonspire's tallest skyscraper, a needle of glass and steel in the Downtown Core with an observation deck at its crown, about as tall as the creature. Rooftop missile teams hold its upper floors. If it falls, it brings down half of downtown with it. It rises at the north end of downtown.
locations.aiSummary: Spire Tower: Neonspire's tallest skyscraper, in the Downtown Core.
locations.imageTags: supertall skyscraper, glass tower, observation deck, antenna spire, downtown skyline

locations.name: Metro Underground
locations.playerDescription: Subway platforms and tunnels under downtown. Too small for you, but the street above them is not.
locations.aiDescription: The Metro Underground: subway platforms and the {{ph:0437786a-18da-4ee6-9d17-a0d9f4eb0c37:world:c3b8f6a6-2c2d-43f8-a5a6-77437fc27f7c}} tunnels under the Downtown Core, where the trains stopped when the sirens started. Stranded commuters walk out along the tracks toward Old Town. The creature cannot fit inside, and a stomp on the street above caves the tunnels in. Its main platforms lie under the west side of downtown.
locations.aiSummary: The Metro Underground: the subway tunnels under downtown.
locations.imageTags: subway station, platform, stopped train, tunnel, emergency lights, cracked ceiling

locations.name: Harborgate Bridge
locations.playerDescription: A suspension bridge over the river mouth, with twin towers and cables you could pluck.
locations.aiDescription: Harborgate Bridge: a suspension bridge with twin towers over the river mouth, joining the Downtown Core to Old Town. Combat engineers have wired its deck with demolition charges to drop it under the creature, and tanks hold its downtown approach. It leaves downtown's south-east corner and runs east to Old Town.
locations.aiSummary: Harborgate Bridge: the suspension bridge between downtown and Old Town.
locations.imageTags: suspension bridge, twin towers, steel cables, river mouth, demolition charges, abandoned cars

locations.name: Old Town
locations.playerDescription: Low brick blocks, a museum quarter, and streets too narrow for your feet.
locations.aiDescription: Old Town: low brick blocks, a museum quarter and narrow streets full of evacuating crowds. Little here is tall, but everything is old and fragile, and the evacuation routes run through it. It sits on the river's east bank, across from downtown.
locations.imageTags: old town, brick buildings, narrow streets, fleeing crowd, evacuation

locations.name: Neonspire Stadium
locations.playerDescription: A domed stadium across the river, its floodlights still on and its crowd still pouring out.
locations.aiDescription: Neonspire Stadium: a domed sports stadium across the river from downtown, beside Old Town. An evening game was in its last minutes when the sirens started. Its floodlights are still on, and the crowd pours out its gates. Attack helicopters use its field as a landing pad. It stands just east of Old Town.
locations.aiSummary: Neonspire Stadium: the domed stadium across the river, its crowd evacuating.
locations.imageTags: stadium, floodlights, sports field, empty seats, helicopter landing, evacuation

locations.name: Industrial Yards
locations.playerDescription: Refineries, fuel depots, and freight lines. Everything here is flammable, including the ground.
locations.aiDescription: The Industrial Yards: refineries, fuel depots, tank farms and freight lines. Damage here chains, one ruptured depot setting off the next, so Destruction climbs fast. The fireballs burn the creature as readily as anything else. They stretch west of the harbor along the bay.
locations.imageTags: oil storage tanks, freight train, railyard, cranes, factory smokestacks, waterfront, fires

locations.name: Bayline Refinery
locations.playerDescription: Cracking towers, flare stacks and a tank farm. One spark here and the whole yard goes up.
locations.aiDescription: Bayline Refinery: the biggest plant in the Industrial Yards, with cracking towers, flare stacks and a tank farm on the bay. Fire crews fight to keep every fire away from the tanks. One ruptured tank here sets off the rest of the yard. It sits on the yards' southern edge, at the water.
locations.aiSummary: Bayline Refinery: the Industrial Yards' largest refinery and tank farm.
locations.imageTags: oil refinery, cylindrical storage tanks, flare stack, distillation column, pipes, burning, black smoke

locations.name: Fort Bastion
locations.playerDescription: The military staging ground on the city’s edge. Runways, hangars, and one very large closed door.
locations.aiDescription: Fort Bastion: the military base on Neonspire's edge. Jets launch from its runways, armor musters in its yards, and General Vasquez commands from its control tower. Its sealed hangar holds Aegis-One. The hardest target in the city. It holds the city's north-west edge.
locations.imageTags: military base, runway, hangars, tanks mustering, floodlights

locations.name: Cedar Hollow
locations.playerDescription: A quiet suburb past the military base: lawns, cul-de-sacs, a mall and a water tower on the ridge.
locations.aiDescription: Cedar Hollow: the commuter suburb past Fort Bastion, with lawns, cul-de-sacs, a shopping mall and a water tower on the ridge. The evacuation highway runs through it, jammed with cars leaving the city. An artillery battery has dug in on the ridge with the whole city in range. It lies north-west of Fort Bastion, beyond the base.
locations.aiSummary: Cedar Hollow: the suburb on the evacuation highway, past Fort Bastion.
locations.imageTags: suburb, houses, cul-de-sac, water tower, traffic jam, ridge, artillery

aToB.hint: out onto the bridge approach ramps

bToA.hint: off the bridge onto the downtown ramps

aToB.hint: down the bridge's Old Town ramps

bToA.hint: up the bridge's Old Town ramps
in through the base's back gate

entities.name: The Creature
entities.playerDescription: A colossal creature wading out of the bay, taller than the towers of Neonspire.
entities.aiDescription: {{char}} is a colossal creature taller than Neonspire's towers. The ground shakes with every step, and its roar sets off car alarms for blocks.
entities.aiSummary: A colossal creature rampaging through a city.

traits.name: Masculine
traits.playerDescription: The news and the military call you "he."

traits.name: Feminine
traits.playerDescription: The news and the military call you "she."

traits.name: Reptile
traits.playerDescription: A hulking reptile on two legs, with a long tail, sharp fangs and heavy claws.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a two-legged reptile with a long tail, sharp fangs and heavy claws. It stomps, bites, and sweeps buildings aside with its tail.

traits.name: Insect
traits.playerDescription: A hulking insect on two legs, with mandibles, armored plates and spiked limbs.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a two-legged insect with mandibles, armored plates and spiked limbs. It slashes, climbs towers, and grips with its spiked limbs.

traits.name: Arachnid
traits.playerDescription: A hulking spider with eight furred legs and venomous mandibles.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a spider with eight furred legs and venomous mandibles. It scuttles over rooftops, spits venom, and spins cables of web between towers.

traits.name: Giant
traits.playerDescription: A human as tall as the towers, with hands that grab, lift and throw.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is a human as tall as the towers. Its hands grab, lift and throw whatever is in reach.

traits.name: Armored Hide
traits.playerDescription: Your hide shrugs off gunfire. All that bulk slows you down.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju's hide shrugs off gunfire and shells, but its bulk makes it slow to turn and react.

traits.name: Short Fuse
traits.playerDescription: Your fury starts high and runs hot. Each burst leaves you more winded.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju's fury starts high and flares fast, and every outburst winds it.

traits.name: Unrelenting
traits.playerDescription: You attack tirelessly. Your body pays for it.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju keeps attacking long after it should tire, and its body takes more damage for it.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.playerDescription: A ranged breath of fire, venom or energy, to match your type. Each blast takes a lot out of you.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju has a breath weapon of fire, venom or energy, matching its type. A blast levels a block or swats aircraft from the sky, and each one exhausts it.

traits.name: Regenerator
traits.playerDescription: Your wounds knit closed as you watch. The healing burns energy you could spend smashing.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju regenerates: its wounds knit closed over minutes, and the healing drains its energy.

traits.name: Wings
traits.playerDescription: Vast wings carry you between districts and over the military's heads. Your frame is lighter and easier to hurt.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju has vast wings. It glides or flies short hops between districts, over cordons and armor. Its frame is lighter and easier to hurt.

traits.name: Berserk State
traits.playerDescription: Let the fury off its leash. A Berserk bar shows and climbs each turn. Rampage climbs on its own and Health drops, more with every turn. Switch it off to recover.
traits.aiDescription: The kaiju is berserk: it charges the nearest target, attacks wildly and ignores pain and caution.

traitGroups.name: Presentation
traitGroups.playerDescription: How the news and the military describe you. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Mutations
traitGroups.playerDescription: Each mutation trades something for something. Take any number.

traitGroups.name: Type
traitGroups.playerDescription: What kind of colossus you are. Pick one.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: How much punishment the creature can still take. It mends slowly.

descriptors.description: Critical. Barely standing; every hit could drop it.
Badly hurt. Bleeding from many wounds; it moves and fights slower.
Hurt. Scorched and scratched, but still at full stride.
Unhurt. Its hide is barely marked.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: The creature's energy for attacks, sprints and climbs. A pause between assaults restores it.

descriptors.description: Spent. It can barely lift a limb and must rest.
Tired. Its movements are slow and heavy.
Winded. Breathing hard, but able to keep going.
Fresh. Ready for anything.

stats.name: Rampage
stats.description: The creature's fury. It rises as it smashes and fights, cools while it holds back, and makes every blow bigger.

descriptors.description: Calm. Its blows land like any big animal's.
Riled. Each blow hits noticeably harder.
Furious. Sweeping strikes level a building at a time.
Unstoppable. Each blow flattens a block.

stats.name: Berserk
stats.description: How deep the creature's frenzy runs. It shows only while Berserk State is on, and it climbs each turn.

descriptors.description: Seething. The frenzy has just taken hold.
Frenzied. It charges whatever is nearest and ignores its wounds.
Wild. It tears into everything in reach and stops only when nothing is left standing near it.
Lost. Nothing is left but the fury.

entities.imageTags: giant kaiju, monster, reptile, dorsal spines, roaring, towering over skyscrapers, harbor water, city

entities.name: Battle Tank
entities.playerDescription: A main battle tank. It fires high-explosive rounds from the street, in pairs and platoons.
entities.aiDescription: Main battle tanks of the National Guard. They roll in by platoon, fire high-explosive rounds from street level, and take cover behind buildings. A stomp crushes one; a thrown car flips one.
entities.aiSummary: Battle tanks: the ground backbone of the military response; high-explosive rounds.
entities.imageTags: main battle tank, city street, military, rubble

entities.name: Attack Helicopter
entities.playerDescription: An attack helicopter. It hovers between the towers and fires missile barrages.
entities.aiDescription: Attack helicopters of the National Guard. They hover between towers, fire missile barrages, and dodge behind buildings. Fast and agile, but one swipe brings one down.
entities.aiSummary: Attack helicopters: missile barrages from the air; agile but fragile.
entities.imageTags: attack helicopter, missiles, city skyline, searchlight

entities.name: Drone
entities.playerDescription: A swarm of armed drones, flown from far away. They sting like a cloud of flies.
entities.aiDescription: Drone swarms: dozens of small armed drones flown by remote operators, hitting with precision strikes from every side. Each drone is a fly to the creature; the swarm is a cloud of stings that blinds and distracts it.
entities.aiSummary: Drone squadrons: precision-strike swarms; to the creature, annoying flies.
entities.imageTags: quadcopter, drone swarm, small military drones, between skyscrapers, city

entities.name: Jet Fighter
entities.playerDescription: A jet fighter. It streaks over the skyline and fires air-to-ground missiles.
entities.aiDescription: Jet fighters from Fort Bastion. They streak over the skyline in pairs, fire air-to-ground missiles, and are gone before the creature can turn. The hardest hits the military has before Aegis-One.
entities.aiSummary: Jet fighters: air-to-ground missile volleys; fast, loud, launched from Fort Bastion.
entities.imageTags: fighter jet, missiles, afterburner, city skyline

entities.name: General Vasquez
entities.playerDescription: The unflappable commander of Neonspire’s defense. Addresses you directly over the city PA, like you might pick up the phone.
entities.aiDescription: General Mara Vasquez, a career artillery officer who commands Neonspire's defense from the control tower at Fort Bastion. Calm in every crisis, she orders each new tier of the response. Between engagements she talks to the creature over the city loudspeakers, dry and polite, with a respect that grows as the city falls.
entities.aiSummary: General Vasquez: unflappable defense commander who addresses the creature over the city PA.
entities.imageTags: 1woman, mature female, military officer, military uniform, short hair, upper body, command center, monitors, stern

entities.name: Aegis-One
entities.playerDescription: The thing they built in case of you. A creature-sized war machine, still in its hangar. For now.
entities.aiDescription: Aegis-One: an experimental combat mech as tall as the creature, sealed in Fort Bastion's hangar with its test pilot strapped in and waiting. It deploys only at the last tier of the Alert Level, when the city is nearly lost. Its arrival is a slow, loud event the whole city watches.
entities.aiSummary: Aegis-One: the creature-scale experimental mech, held back until the highest alert.
entities.imageTags: giant mecha, hangar, floodlights, cockpit, military prototype

entities.name: Channel 8 News Chopper
entities.playerDescription: A news helicopter that follows you everywhere at a not-quite-safe distance, narrating your rampage live to the whole city.
entities.aiDescription: The Channel 8 news chopper: a civilian helicopter that shadows the creature at a not-quite-safe distance while its reporter narrates the rampage live to the whole city. The military orders it out of the airspace; it stays. It reacts loudly to the creature's most dramatic moments. Its reporter leads every broadcast with the top stories: {{ph:c20225e7-8aa3-4e25-9268-586edb158450:world:5742b48c-4e42-4f2b-aa70-923251376074}}.
entities.aiSummary: Channel 8 news chopper: fearless civilian shadow giving the rampage live commentary.
entities.imageTags: news helicopter, camera operator, city skyline, spotlight

entities.name: Police Cordon
entities.playerDescription: Patrol cars, barricades and officers with megaphones, trying to hold a line against something a hundred times their size.
entities.aiDescription: Neonspire police cordons: patrol cars parked across the lanes, sawhorse barricades and officers with megaphones and rifles. They hold the first line while the military mobilizes, and they fall back to guide the evacuation the moment the creature comes close.
entities.aiSummary: Police cordons: the first, smallest line of defense; they fall back to guide the evacuation.
entities.imageTags: police cars, barricade, flashing lights, megaphone, city street

entities.name: Navy Destroyer
entities.playerDescription: A Navy destroyer in the harbor channel. Its deck guns and missiles fire from the water.
entities.aiDescription: A Navy destroyer holding the harbor channel beyond the breakwater. It fires deck guns and missiles from the water and keeps between the creature and the open sea. It is helpless at close range: a wave or a grab can capsize it.
entities.aiSummary: Navy destroyer: deck guns and missiles from the harbor channel.
entities.imageTags: navy destroyer, warship, deck gun firing, harbor channel, sea spray, gun smoke

entities.name: Last Ferry
entities.playerDescription: The last evacuation ferry, packed to the rails and pulling away from the slip.
entities.aiDescription: The last evacuation ferry out of the terminal, packed to the rails with evacuees and pulling away from the slip as fast as it can. Its crew sounds the horn at the creature. It always clears the harbor in time.
entities.aiSummary: The last ferry: packed with evacuees, pulling out of the harbor.
entities.imageTags: ferry, passenger ship, harbor, waves, ship wake, open water

entities.name: Rooftop Missile Team
entities.playerDescription: Soldiers on the rooftops with shoulder-fired missiles, small enough to miss.
entities.aiDescription: Rooftop missile teams: soldiers with shoulder-fired missiles on the upper floors and roofs of downtown's towers. They fire, run for the stairwell, and fire again from the next roof. A team is too small for the creature to see until its missile hits.
entities.aiSummary: Rooftop missile teams: shoulder-fired missiles from downtown's towers.
entities.imageTags: soldiers, rooftop, rocket launcher, aiming up, skyscraper roof, smoke trail

entities.name: Stranded Commuters
entities.playerDescription: Commuters from the stopped trains, walking out along the tracks by flashlight.
entities.aiDescription: Commuters stranded when the Metro trains stopped. Transit staff lead them along the tracks by flashlight toward the Old Town platforms. Each footstep above shakes dust from the tunnel ceiling onto them, and they always reach the surface in time.
entities.aiSummary: Stranded commuters: walking out of the subway tunnels toward Old Town.
entities.imageTags: commuters, subway tunnel, flashlights, train tracks, falling dust

entities.name: Combat Engineers
entities.playerDescription: Engineers wiring the bridge with demolition charges, to drop it under you.
entities.aiDescription: Army combat engineers wiring Harborgate Bridge's deck and towers with demolition charges. They plan to blow the bridge while the creature is on it and drop it into the river. They need a few more minutes, and they will set it off early if they must.
entities.aiSummary: Combat engineers: rigging Harborgate Bridge to drop under the creature.
entities.imageTags: soldiers, hard hats, demolition charges, bridge cables, detonator, bridge deck

entities.name: Stalled Drivers
entities.playerDescription: Drivers who left their cars on the bridge deck and run for the far ramps.
entities.aiDescription: Drivers caught on Harborgate Bridge when the traffic stopped. They leave their cars with the doors open and run for the far ramps, while the combat engineers wave them through. They all reach solid ground in time.
entities.aiSummary: Stalled drivers: running off Harborgate Bridge on foot.
entities.imageTags: abandoned cars, open car doors, people running, bridge deck, traffic jam

entities.name: Stadium Crowd
entities.playerDescription: Forty thousand fans streaming out of the stadium gates, team scarves and all.
entities.aiDescription: The stadium crowd: forty thousand fans streaming out of Neonspire Stadium's gates into the parking lots, guided by stewards with megaphones. Some stop to film the creature. They all get clear in time.
entities.aiSummary: Stadium crowd: fans evacuating Neonspire Stadium.
entities.imageTags: stadium crowd, sports fans, team scarves, phones filming, stadium gates, floodlights

entities.name: Refinery Fire Crew
entities.playerDescription: Firefighters in silver suits, spraying foam to keep the fire off the tanks.
entities.aiDescription: The Bayline Refinery fire crew: firefighters in silver heat suits with foam cannons, fighting to keep each fire away from the tank farm. They pull back when the creature comes close and go back in as soon as it moves on.
entities.aiSummary: Refinery fire crew: foam crews holding back the refinery fires.
entities.imageTags: firefighters, silver heat suits, fire truck, refinery fire

entities.name: Artillery Battery
entities.playerDescription: Self-propelled guns dug in on the ridge, with the whole city in range.
entities.aiDescription: A battery of self-propelled howitzers dug in on the ridge above Cedar Hollow. It shells the creature from miles away, guided by spotters in the city. Its shells arrive with a whistle, and its guns are slow to turn.
entities.aiSummary: Artillery battery: howitzers shelling the creature from Cedar Hollow's ridge.
entities.imageTags: self-propelled howitzers, artillery, muzzle flash, ridge, camouflage netting

entities.name: Cedar Hollow Evacuees
entities.playerDescription: Families packing their cars on the lawns, with the highway already jammed.
entities.aiDescription: Cedar Hollow's families, packing cars on their lawns and joining the jammed evacuation highway. Police wave them through the intersections. They watch the skyline in their mirrors, and they all get clear in time.
entities.aiSummary: Cedar Hollow evacuees: families leaving the suburb on the jammed highway.
entities.imageTags: crowd, families, suburban street, packed cars, minivan, traffic jam, evacuation

entities.name: Dr. Lena Sorensen
entities.playerDescription: The civilian analyst studying your every move from Fort Bastion, looking for a weakness.
entities.aiDescription: Dr. Lena Sorensen, the civilian threat analyst at Fort Bastion. She reviews every frame of footage for a weakness and briefs General Vasquez between engagements. She suspects the creature's flinch means something, and she cannot prove it yet.
entities.aiSummary: Dr. Sorensen: the threat analyst at Fort Bastion who studies the creature's every move.
entities.imageTags: scientist, lab coat, glasses, monitors, war room, tired eyes

entities.name: Captain Theo Ward
entities.playerDescription: Aegis-One's test pilot. He has been strapped into the cockpit since the first siren.
entities.aiDescription: Captain Theo Ward, the test pilot of Aegis-One. He has sat strapped into its cockpit in the sealed hangar since the first siren, asking for clearance every hour. He launches only at the last tier, on General Vasquez's order.
entities.aiSummary: Captain Ward: Aegis-One's test pilot, waiting in the hangar for clearance.
entities.imageTags: test pilot, flight suit, helmet, cockpit, hangar, determined

dictionaries.name: The Neonspire Dossier
dictionaries.description: City lore for the rampage: the designation, the escalation doctrine, the defenders, and the tone.

entries.name: The Designation
entries.value: The military designates the creature {{ph:5bc823b3-c642-48da-ad53-589bffab7870:world:721a3ee7-ae29-4b61-9e3f-c34c25612705}} — radio chatter, news broadcasts, and General Vasquez all use the codename. The creature emerged earlier today from {{ph:956c6b88-e32e-447d-9f14-7a43523a254a:world:1971fa19-5a53-4102-86a4-389c9b99bc0a}}.

entries.name: Escalation Doctrine
entries.value: Neonspire's defense climbs in tiers, matching the Alert Level stat: police cordons first, then National Guard tanks and helicopters, then the full military with jets and drone swarms, and at the last tier Aegis-One. Each tier arrives loudly and visibly, as a set piece. Each tier holds until the next one arrives.

entries.name: General Vasquez
entries.value: General Mara Vasquez commands the defense from Fort Bastion's control tower: career artillery, decades of service, calm in every crisis. Between engagements she talks to the creature over the city loudspeakers, dry and professional, with a respect that grows as the city falls. The city trusts her completely.

entries.name: Aegis-One
entries.value: Aegis-One is the countermeasure Neonspire hoped never to need: a combat mech as tall as the creature, decades of secret budget in one sealed hangar at Fort Bastion. Its test pilot has asked for clearance since the first siren. It deploys only at the last tier, and when it walks out of the hangar, the whole city watches.

entries.name: Evacuation Protocol
entries.value: Neonspire drills for this. Civilians stream along marked evacuation routes, through Old Town and out the evacuation highway past Cedar Hollow, and they always get clear in time: pulled from under falling rubble, ferried out just ahead of the wave. The story is a disaster movie, and its spectacle is buildings and machines.

entries.name: Chain Reactions
entries.value: Fires in the Industrial Yards chain: one ruptured depot sets off the next, and a single blow can light a whole tank farm. Chained explosions raise Destruction fast, and the fireballs burn the creature standing in the middle of them.

entries.name: Channel 8
entries.value: The Channel 8 news chopper has been on the creature since the harbor, narrating live to every screen in the city. Dramatic flair gets commentary; a truly spectacular piece of destruction gets a replay. The military keeps ordering it out of the airspace. It keeps not leaving.

entries.name: The Flinch
entries.value: {{ph:5bc823b3-c642-48da-ad53-589bffab7870:world:fa037c74-1b27-4388-8468-049ec3e0cec9}} recoils from {{ph:ffc6c542-2a2d-46db-a1af-885258a55683:world:c96f7701-a3bb-4c0c-8209-b06dd0c2bb64}}: a reflex flinch with no explanation. No one has connected the dots yet. Dr. Lena Sorensen at Fort Bastion is the closest. If the military ever works it out, it will use it at once.

entries.name: Ferry Terminal
entries.value: The Ferry Terminal sits at the harbor mouth, a glass ticket hall over steel ferry slips. The last ferries load evacuees under the creature's shadow, and a Navy destroyer holds the channel beyond the breakwater to cover them.

entries.name: Spire Tower
entries.value: Spire Tower is Neonspire's tallest skyscraper, a needle of glass over the Downtown Core with an observation deck at its crown. Rooftop missile teams hold its upper floors. If it falls, it falls across half of downtown, and the whole city sees it go.

entries.name: Metro Underground
entries.value: The Metro Underground runs under the Downtown Core. The {{ph:0437786a-18da-4ee6-9d17-a0d9f4eb0c37:world:c3b8f6a6-2c2d-43f8-a5a6-77437fc27f7c}} tunnels link its platforms to Old Town, and the trains stopped where they stood when the sirens started. Stranded commuters walk out along the tracks. The tunnels are too small for the creature, but a stomp above caves them in.

entries.name: Harborgate Bridge
entries.value: Harborgate Bridge spans the river mouth between the Downtown Core and Old Town, a suspension bridge with twin towers. Combat engineers have wired its deck with demolition charges, to drop it under the creature. Tanks hold its downtown approach.

entries.name: Neonspire Stadium
entries.value: Neonspire Stadium sits across the river from downtown, beside Old Town. An evening game was in its last minutes when the sirens started, and the crowd still streams out its gates. Attack helicopters use its field as a landing pad.

entries.name: Bayline Refinery
entries.value: Bayline Refinery is the biggest plant in the Industrial Yards: cracking towers, flare stacks and a tank farm on the bay. Fire crews in silver suits fight to keep every fire away from the tanks. One rupture here lights the whole yard.

entries.name: Cedar Hollow
entries.value: Cedar Hollow is the commuter suburb past Fort Bastion: lawns, cul-de-sacs, a shopping mall and a water tower on the ridge. The evacuation highway runs through it, so the traffic out of the city crawls past its lawns. An artillery battery has dug in on its ridge, with the whole city in range.

values.text: the ocean trench beyond the bay
a collapsed research lab deep beneath the city
a meteor that broke apart over the harbor
a sealed vault under Old Town that should have stayed sealed
the exact note of the evacuation sirens
the smell of the old harbor
the military's vow to stop the creature

tools.name: log_landmark
tools.description:
Purpose: Log a landmark the creature destroyed this turn, so the city keeps the loss and Destruction counts it.
Use when: The narration shows the creature bring down one of the listed landmarks. Call it once for each landmark that fell, before you give the stat changes.
Input: landmark — the landmark that fell.
Output: A short confirmation with the new Destruction. Then give the stat changes.
